# Figure — The Straight Vāk Layering of the Four Registers

**Asset:** [vak-register-layering.svg](./vak-register-layering.svg)

## Proposition

The four publication registers carry the levels of Vāk in straight order, ratified 2026-09-07: **Symbolon / parā; Matheme / paśyantī; Mytheme / madhyamā; Episteme / vaikharī**. Symbolon holds the relation; Matheme gives its visionary operative logic; Mytheme forms its lived visual and narrative operations; Episteme articulates instituted knowledge, history and warrant. The figure makes the ratified order and its non-permutability inspectable.

## Declared data (inputs)

- [Central plan](../../../../../the-return-of-zero-central-plan.md), mythic rule: "The straight Vāk layering ratified on September 7 governs: **Symbolon / parā; Matheme / paśyantī; Mytheme / madhyamā; Episteme / vaikharī**," with the register offices as stated there; and Amendment 2026-09-07, clause 2 (paśyantī "the visionary operative logic, more primordial than the mytheme"; madhyamā "formed visual/narrative operations built through the logic").
- [A06 — Vāk](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A06-Vak.md): the descent from formative capacity to sign; the source-side offices of the levels (parā the Supreme Word from which letters and words derive; paśyantī and madhyamā formative and mental articulation; vaikharī the explicit utterance), sourced through the Singh / Abhinavagupta source house's introduction leads.
- Register offices as carried by the four register roots (`symbolon/README.md`, `matheme`, `mytheme`, `episteme`) and their `register-domain` declarations.

## Transformations (construction method)

Hand-authored SVG. Each ratified register/level pair is set as one band; the left cell states the register office, the right cell the speech-level office; downward arrows render the descent the plan declares. No relation is drawn that the declared data does not state: there is no return arrow, no ladder of sub-levels, and no identification of the registers with the Binary Explication four-file offices (the amendment declares those foundations as nested, not as drawn content).

## Invariant

The band order is exactly the ratified string `Symbolon/parā → Matheme/paśyantī → Mytheme/madhyamā → Episteme/vaikharī`. Any re-render must preserve: (a) the straight order; (b) the pairing of each register with exactly one level; (c) the descent direction (parā prior to determination, vaikharī instituted).

## Proof boundary and omissions

- The figure renders a **ratified authorial decision**; it does not derive it.
- Nāda's vibratory office (A06 #1) is real in the argument but is not part of the ratified register mapping and is not drawn.
- The Binary Explication four-file foundation (definition, process, quilt, music; `0`, `/`, `1`, `0/1` returned) is declared by the amendment and deliberately omitted here — drawing it would suggest file offices are interchangeable with publication registers, which the amendment refuses.
- The earlier open proposal to permute Matheme and Mytheme is shown only as the refused alternative named in the guard note; it is historical provenance.
- The Śaiva speech-level descriptions rest on source-matched introduction leads, not quotation-verified passages (A06 Unresolved Delta); the figure claims the mapping, not textual establishment of the levels.

## Status

Mapping: **Argued** (authorial ratification). Speech-level offices: **Argued from** the Singh / Abhinavagupta introduction leads; passage-level verification open.

## Caption

The straight Vāk layering ratified 2026-09-07: each publication register carries one level of speech — Symbolon the relation itself (parā), Matheme its visionary operative logic (paśyantī), Mytheme the formed lived operations built through that logic (madhyamā), Episteme the instituted, addressable articulation (vaikharī). The order is descent, and the register/level pairing is fixed: the figure is the reference rendering of that ratification. *Status: Argued (authorial ratification; speech-level offices Argued from source-side introduction leads). Source of record: the central plan's mythic rule and A06 — Vāk.*

## Alt text

A vertical diagram of four stacked bands connected by downward arrows labelled "descent", ordered top to bottom as Symbolon/parā, Matheme/paśyantī, Mytheme/madhyamā, Episteme/vaikharī. Each band pairs the register office (holds the relation; visionary operative logic; lived visual and narrative operations; instituted knowledge, history and warrant) with the speech-level office (Supreme Word prior to determination; formative seeing speech; mental articulation; explicit utterance). A guard note states the refused Matheme/Mytheme permutation, and a status band marks the mapping as Argued.
